turns.q: For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
turns.replyTail:
Cancel
Message from Flo 🩸: For the easiest, lowest-risk start, I’d suggest trying one pair of Leakproof Underwear. You can wear and wash that pair for 30 days; if it isn’t right for you, you can request a refund of the item price or a free exchange for another size or style. If you prefer no protection at all, choose Essential underwear, which is for everyday wear and has zero absorbency. Our quick quiz can also recommend a Leakproof Underwear style based on your needs and preferred silhouette.
